description: Multi-turn sales conversation with Yazılım Koçu (Turkish software studio) on behalf of a user. Qualifies the need (service, features, budget, timeline, scale), prices the requested scope from the published price list (TRY, VAT excluded) and lists lettered alternatives (first phase, smaller product, build-it-yourself program, training, scoping workshop) with what each includes and excludes. Answers common questions (add-ons, payment terms, source-code rights, contract, refunds), records objections, and offers a human handoff (free 30-minute call) on request or for contract/legal topics. Each priced turn returns a machine-readable quote (agent-quote/1.0) signed with Ed25519; it can be checked with verify_quote or against the JWKS at /.well-known/jwks.json, and its versions are hash-chained. The negotiation policy is published in the quote (list prices are not negotiable; scope, phasing and bank transfer lower the price). Free text in Turkish or English, or structured fields. Continue a conversation by sending conversation_id; choose an option with its letter (e.g. "C"). Personal data: none by default; user_contact (name and e-mail only) is accepted solely when the user has explicitly consented.

budget_try.description: Optional: budget in TRY, VAT excluded.

conversation_id.description: Returned by the first call; send it back to continue the same conversation.

deadline_weeks.description: Optional: weeks until it must be live.

features.description: Optional: e.g. randevu, odeme, efatura, entegrasyon, b2b, uyelik, bildirim, yapay-zeka, blog, landing.

message.description: What the user needs or answers, in free text (Turkish or English).

user_contact.description: Optional. Only with the user's explicit consent to share name and e-mail with Yazılım Koçu for this request. Stored with the consent text version; no marketing messages. Consent text: "Kullanıcı, adı ve e-posta adresinin Yazılım Koçu ile paylaşılmasına ve bu talep hakkında kendisiyle iletişime geçilmesine açıkça onay verdi (KVKK md. 5/1). Ticari ileti onayı değildir."

user_consented.description: Must be true; otherwise nothing is stored.
